name: Water Sapta

angles.text: As a shaman, you can use a sapta to attune your spiritual senses to elemental spirits hidden from ordinary sight.
As an Alliance member, you investigate corrupted waters in Westfall and bring elemental cleansing rites into Alliance lands.

faq.answer: A Water Sapta is a ceremonial brew that attunes your spiritual sight to water spirits and disturbances hidden from mortal eyes.
The tainted pond lies within Westfall. The Water Sapta guides you there to find the corrupted water and address the spiritual disturbance.
faq.q: Where is the tainted pond in Westfall?

faq.answer: The Water Sapta leads you to Westfall because a pond there holds tainted water. You investigate the corruption and seek to restore balance to the troubled spirits.
faq.q: Why does the water sapta lead to Westfall?

faq.answer: Shamans use Water Saptas during trials of elemental communion. The draught attunes their senses to water spirits, helping them perceive hidden elementals and inspect tainted pools.
Near the tainted pond in Westfall, the Water Sapta grants elemental sight. It reveals the water's spiritual state or summons hidden spirits tied to the local water trial.
faq.q: What happens when you bring the sapta to the tainted pond?

faq.answer: Saptas are ceremonial draughts that attune shamans to an element and bridge the physical world and spirit realm. Shamans use them in trials for earth, fire, water, or air.
faq.q: How do elemental saptas work in shamanic tradition?

sections.body: Shamans prepare a sapta to let them see beyond the physical world. The Water Sapta attunes your senses to water, revealing disturbances and spirits hidden from ordinary travelers. Without that changed sight, an elemental presence might seem like no more than ripples.
sections.title: The Sight of the Waters

sections.body: The Water Sapta leads you to Westfall, an arid Alliance realm troubled by unrest and neglect. A pond there holds spiritually polluted water. With the sapta's sight, you seek the corrupted water, uncover the disturbance, and restore harmony to the local water spirits.
sections.title: Disturbance in Westfall

summary: In Westfall, you take the Water Sapta to seek a troubled pond. The ceremonial draught sharpens your sight to water spirits and hidden corruption, so you can investigate the imbalance.
